products.title: Beef Donburi Bowl
products.description: Tender sliced beef served over steamed Japanese rice, topped with fresh scallions and finished with a savory soy-based glaze. A comforting and flavorful rice bowl inspired by traditional Japanese cuisine.

products.title: beef noodle soup bokchoy
products.description: Rich and flavorful beef broth served with tender beef slices, chewy noodles, and fresh bok choy. Finished with aromatic herbs, chili, and savory seasonings for a comforting bowl with a gentle spicy kick.

products.title: Classic Beef Ramen
products.description: Rich and savory beef broth served with springy ramen noodles, tender sliced beef, a soft-boiled egg, and fresh scallions. Finished with aromatic seasonings for a warm, comforting bowl full of authentic flavor.

products.title: Rosemary Grilled Steak
products.description: Juicy grilled beef steak seasoned with fresh rosemary, garlic, and cracked black pepper. Cooked to perfection and served with a rich, savory finish that highlights the steak's natural flavor.

products.title: Spicy Grilled Chicken
products.description: Tender grilled chicken marinated with bold spices and flame-cooked to perfection. Served with fresh red onion, green chili, and aromatic herbs for a smoky, juicy dish with a satisfying kick.

products.title: Crispy Fried Chicken
products.description: Golden, crispy chicken tenders made with juicy chicken breast, served alongside a fresh red cabbage slaw tossed in a light, tangy dressing. Finished with herbs and a savory dipping sauce for a satisfying balance of crunch and flavor.

products.title: Stuffed Zucchini
products.description: Fresh zucchini boats stuffed with a savory blend of herbs, bell peppers, and seasoned vegetables, then fried until perfectly golden and crispy. Served with a tender, flavorful filling and a satisfying crunchy finish.
